home.introTitle: A warm, well-equipped home in Rethymno
home.introBody: Lena Apt offers two comfortable bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and two balconies to relax on — thoughtfully arranged so you feel at home from the moment you arrive. Whether you're exploring Rethymno's old town, the surrounding beaches or the rest of Crete, Lena Apt is a calm, comfortable base to return to.

apartment.title: A closer look at Lena Apt
apartment.intro: Lena Apt is arranged over comfortable, well-defined spaces — two bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom and two balconies — designed for an easy, relaxed stay in Rethymno.
apartment.about3Heading: Why we built it this way
apartment.about1: Welcome to Lena Apt, a bright, modern 61 m² apartment just 80 meters from the sea. Step outside, and in a few minutes you're already on the sand! All around and close by you'll find supermarkets, shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants, open at any hour. The lively seafront promenade and the city's central market are just 700 meters away — perfect for an evening stroll (or a morning one or a midnight one — no judgment here). History lovers will enjoy having the Rethymnon Archaeological Museum just 1.8 km away, while the Venetian Harbor, with its cobbled streets and seaside tavernas, is barely a 20-minute walk.
apartment.about2: Step inside, and you'll find a bright living room with a TV and a spacious dining area for your meals. The kitchen comes fully equipped with everything you might need. Out on the large balcony, you can enjoy your morning coffee or an evening glass of wine. There are two comfortable bedrooms to rest in, with four beds in total — a queen in the main bedroom, two singles, and a sofa bed in the living room. Both bedrooms have wardrobes for storage and air conditioning for the hot summer days. The second bedroom even has its own small, quiet balcony we're sure you'll love as much as we do. The bathroom, though compact, is comfortable, with a shower, washing machine, and hairdryer. In short, we've made sure you won't be missing a thing.
apartment.about3: We built Lena Apt with a lot of thought and care, because we believe a vacation deserves a place that truly feels like home — not just a room to sleep in. We happily recommend it to families traveling with children, couples looking for some quiet by the sea, and groups of friends ready to enjoy a proper Cretan summer. Whoever you are, we wanted you to have a space made for you.
apartment.about4: When our guests write to us, they usually mention: how close they were to the beach, and how convenient the location was for their whole trip — even Chania Airport, about 69 km away, was never a problem. They also talk about how comfortable the apartment felt and how welcome we made them feel, because that's how we try to treat every guest — like family. An apartment made for everyone, with the same warmth for each of you.
